ops.body: - The loading skeleton still pulses through `Animated`, which renders on the web: about sixty small commits a second while a memo or video loads

argv: A hop's dots are hard to see
the clock at the last view is settled by RC24
ops.body: - A hop's dots are hard to see where they lie over the walked-street line (the journey's picture); in landscape there is no room under a card, so its pin sits partly under it (RC14); a change of the screen's size mid-replay (rotation, Safari's bar) rebuilds the telling, untested; the camera's arithmetic does not wrap at the antimeridian; `ceremony/room.ts` assumes a 34 px caption strip where the web's is about 32

argv: The seam of decision 0086 is wider
the scrim has its field (RC35); the last slices' fields added
ops.body: - The seam of decision 0086 is wider than the plan said. From the camera and breaks: `Frame.hops` and `Showing.hops` (a hop is drawn by the map in its `gap-links` layer, so it is no overlay) and `Frame.clockFade`; `Frame.dim` is gone. From the last slices: `CeremonyOptions.whole` (the walk's bounds and the room the card leaves; the screens pass bounds and room, never a view), `holdOpen`, `namePassed`; `Frame.date`, `dateOpacity`, `scrim`, `still`; the overlay kinds `picture`, `stack`, `passed`; `CardOverlay.drift`, `videos`, `turn`, `turnIn`. A dotted line cannot be revealed by paint (a ride's dashes again), so a hop is sent as data while it draws, at most every 100 ms and only during the break

- [owner] The card's map leaves 116 px at the top where it left 48 (`WHOLE_TOP`: the top row and a standing picture's height), on both replays and after Skip too: the last view and the card are one view (RC24), and at 320 px the top row and the date sat on the walk's pictures. On a 320 by 568 phone the walk has about 56 px of room above the card

- [owner] The last view's date stands where the clock stood, between Hold and Skip, in one line: the full weekday only with 250 px of room ("Thu, Nov 19" at 320 px). The prototype shows the full date under the clock; there it lay over pictures at 320 px

- [owner] A moment's memo plays after its videos, the card still up, its notes beside from the start (two sounds never overlap; the reading taken of RC37 and the steward's S2). Each video in turn is a new player, so iPhone Safari may ask "Tap for sound" for each. In a moment with videos the grid's cells fill one picture's room and are not square

- [owner] A walk shorter than what zoom 15 shows opens closer than the walking zoom (the whole is capped at 17), so its "dive" pulls back; capping the whole at 15 would change the card's map too. The first beat's faint trace cuts off at the path's first frame and the walker appears 1.9 s into the dive with no fade (the prototype fades both). The first beat's fit keeps a map's bearing: a card's map turned by hand, then Watch again, opens turned and snaps north at the path's first frame

- What can cover what on the stage: a standing picture covers a note's pin at the same stop until the card; a tall stack can stand over the east end of the walk on the last view; the passed place's name on the last view is a large pill over the ground under the path, and during the path its whisper can lie across a pin and the line (the journey's picture); a picture and that name can cover each other. With reduce motion and no bounds (a day of placeless moments) pictures are not drawn. A card is 204 px wide where it was 211 under about 341 px, to stay clear of the stack

- React commits on a stretch rose from about 3.4 to 6 a second in the harness with the last slices (frames a second did not fall: 32.9 unthrottled, 22.1 at 4x); the reading is one picture and one stack entry landing as each stretch starts, unprofiled. The card's sheet is laid out twice during the path, once unseen, so its height is known before the close

- Thin in the last slices' tests: RC25 is read on the seeded walk with one passed place (two names, and the one line for more than two, have no pose test and no picture; in the `walk` journey a walk's passed places are not known during its first replay, cause not looked into and older than this slice); RC32's spring is unit-tested only; RC47 is a scan and `storySteps`, no screen reader ran; no journey ran at the tests-first commits; the harness's windows before and after differ (the dive and the close are in the later one)

- [ ] **Do:** finish a walk with streets read and watch its first replay to the end without touching it. **Expect:** the walked streets light up in the order walked over about 3 s, then the path begins from that same view with no jump (whether MapLibre RN's `fitBounds` lands on the telling's own fit is untried); at the end the walker stands, the camera pulls back about 3 s to the whole walk above the card's place, the date shows between Hold and Skip, each place passed is named beside its mark in dark ink, and the map does not move when the card arrives. (RC23, RC24, RC25, RC26)

- [ ] **Do:** replay a walk with three photos at different places, then one with more photos than the stack holds (about 15 on a small phone). **Expect:** each card shrinks onto its own place, a small picture stands there and follows the map as the camera moves, and no pin for it shows until the card; the stack grows up the right edge, stops under Next, the lowest entry drops as each new one lands, no number shows, and a tap opens all of them, latest first. (RC28, RC29, RC30, RC31, RC34)

- [ ] **Do:** watch a card come and go, then again with Reduce Motion on; replay a moment of two photos, two videos (one trimmed) and a memo; with VoiceOver on, open a replay. **Expect:** the map darkens slightly under the card and a photo drifts closer, with Reduce Motion neither fades nor drifts and a new stack entry appears in place; the moment is one card: the photos as a grid, each video in turn with sound (the trimmed one only its kept part), then the memo with the card still up; with VoiceOver the moments come one at a time with Continue, as before, with no stage, stack or pictures. (RC32, RC35, RC36, RC37, RC47)
